statements.text: STIFTELSEN LIA GÅRD RETREATSENTER has the legal form STI and organisation number 927293056.
The company's registered activity is Christian retreat and course operations.
The company's website reports that Lia Gård is an inhabited resting place outside the asphalt under an open sky for those on their way.
From the period 2023-12-31 to 2024-12-31, revenue decreased from 15,965,803 NOK to 9,560,570 NOK, which is a down direction of 40.1 percent.
From the period 2024-12-31 to 2025-12-31, revenue increased from 9,560,570 NOK to 9,714,082 NOK, representing an upward change of 1.6 percent.
